ceramic.hero_title: From Earth to Table: Forms Shaped with Patience
ceramic.hero_subtitle: Timeless stoneware pieces hand-thrown one by one in our studio from natural clays and lead-free glazes, fired at 1240 degrees.
ceramic.story_text: Nothing in our studio is made in the rush of mass production. Natural clay is thrown by hand, dried slowly, bisque-fired at 950 degrees, hand-glazed with natural mineral glazes and finally taken through a 1240-degree firing. Every plate and mug that reaches your table carries two weeks of patient craftsmanship.
ceramic.story_quote: Instead of perfect symmetry, we believe in the warmth of natural character and the maker's hand.

pillars.title: 1240°C Stoneware Strength
pillars.desc: High-temperature firing gives porcelain-like hardness, fully dishwasher and oven safe.

pillars.title: Lead-Free Natural Glazes
pillars.desc: Mineral-based studio glazes that are 100% food safe and free of chemicals.

pillars.title: Breakage-Guaranteed Shipping
pillars.desc: Custom cardboard and honeycomb kraft protection with a zero-damage promise to your door.

testimonials.quote: The weight of the mugs, how they sit in the hand and the matte texture of the glaze are outstanding. My morning coffee ritual has completely changed.
Every dish we serve becomes a work of art on these plates. Highly recommended.

faqs.question: Can the products be washed in the dishwasher?
faqs.answer: Yes. Thanks to the 1240°C high-temperature stoneware firing, all our plates and mugs can be safely washed in the dishwasher.

faqs.question: What do you do if something breaks during shipping?
faqs.answer: We pack our parcels in shock-resistant honeycomb packaging. In case of damage, just send us a photo and we will ship a replacement right away.

leather.hero_title: Leather Goods That Grow More Beautiful with Time and Last for Generations
leather.hero_subtitle: Lifelong accessories made one by one with hand-stitched waxed thread from vegetable-tanned Italian leather.
leather.story_title: Waxed Thread and Double-Needle Hand Stitching
leather.story_text: Machines can finish a seam quickly, but when one stitch breaks the whole seam unravels. We punch every hole with a hand chisel and use the traditional saddle stitch, locking two needles and waxed linen thread together. Our leathers are tanned with oak bark and chestnut shells rather than chrome, and over the years they develop a living, noble patina.
leather.story_quote: In a fast-consumption world, we make timeless pieces that gain value as they age.

pillars.title: Traditional Saddle Hand Stitching
pillars.desc: Seams hand-stitched with two needles, with a strength no machine can imitate.

pillars.title: Vegetable-Tanned Leather
pillars.desc: Natural leather treated with plant extracts, free of harmful chemicals, that develops a patina over time.

pillars.title: Lifetime Stitching Guarantee
pillars.desc: Every handmade leather product from our workshop comes with free lifetime repair against stitch failure.

testimonials.quote: I have used the wallet every day for six months. It gets better as the color darkens and the leather settles. The craftsmanship is superb.

faqs.question: How do you recommend caring for leather?
faqs.answer: Applying natural beeswax or a colorless natural leather conditioner once a year is enough to keep the leather soft and water-repellent.
